children: Trilogy Metals closed a $17.8 million strategic equity investment from the U.S. Department of War, issuing 8,215,570 units at $2.17 each, with attached warrants covering up to 6,161,678 shares at $0.01 for 10 years. Alongside the Investment Agreement, the company executed a Cooperation Agreement with the Investor, South32 USA Exploration, and Ambler Metals, plus Participation and Registration Rights Agreements at closing on September 11, 2026. The package enhances Trilogy Metals' liquidity, aligns stakeholders on collaboration parameters, and provides the Investor with pro rata participation and customary registration rights.
